text:
maria_sales: Hey team — ACME POC asks if we can do BYOK with HSM-backed keys for the hosted POC and what rotation / audit guarantees we can give. Also they want CAIQ/SIG answers for vendor risk. Can we get a short set of copy they can drop into their risk doc? cc @jordan_se @sam_security
jordan_se: Short answer: hosted API supports KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) for envelope encryption; we do not persist customer plaintext. For BYOK HSM: we support external KMS (BYOK) in Dedicated/Private deployments today; hosted BYOK with customer HSM is limited — we can run a scoped POC in Private mode or a transient flow in a sandbox. I'll list specifics for the CAIQ answers.
sam_security: For the CAIQ/SIG responses we need explicit statements about: at-rest encryption, in-transit TLS, key custody model, key rotation cadence, HSM attestation, access control and audit logging, and whether plaintext ever touches our managed control plane. I can draft recommended wording.
lee_infra: For a POC we can spin up a Private (VPC) sandbox with a transient BYOK workflow. Flow: customer provisions an HSM-backed KMS or a KMS key, we configure kms-provider and use envelope encryption. Example env snippet: ```env KMS_PROVIDER=aws KMS_KEY_ID=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234``` Rotation is customer-driven but we can wire up automated rotation via the KMS if they want.
tess_ae: Customer will push back on not having hosted HSM BYOK — need short pricing language and timeline for Dedicated vs Hosted POC.
jordan_se: Pricing note: Dedicated/Private with BYOK/HSM has an infra reservation and a setup fee + higher per-token compute due to isolation. For POC we can offer a timeboxed proof (2 weeks) at a reduced rate — I'll sync with finance. For CAIQ answers: envelope encryption + keys never stored unencrypted, access via IAM, audit logs retained 90 days by default (extendable).
sam_security: Suggested SIG phrasing: "Customer-managed keys: Supported in Private and Dedicated deployments. When configured, customer keys are used for envelope encryption; Redwood never stores plaintext nor the customer's unencrypted key material. Access to key operations is controlled via IAM and logged to customer-managed audit sinks. HSM attestation available when customer supplies an HSM-backed KMS provider; Redwood validates provider attestation metadata."
legal_bot: Note: avoid contractual promises about HSM attestation for Hosted mode until legal has signed off. Use "can be supported" language and surface exceptions.
maria_sales: Can someone produce a one-page Q/A and a paste-ready CAIQ block I can drop into their vendor review today? Need high-level + two example snippets (one for Hosted constraints, one for Private/Dedicated).
jordan_se: I'll draft the one-pager and drop into /security/presales/answers and paste the snippet here by EOD. Quick CAIQ snippet (copy/paste): ```We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS, GCP, Azure). Keys are used for envelope encryption; plaintext is not stored in Redwood systems. Key rotation can be customer-initiated or automated via KMS policies; recommended rotation cadence for symmetric keys is 90 days. HSM-backed keys are supported in Dedicated/Private deployments with customer-supplied attestation metadata.```
sam_security: +1. Add: "Audit logs can be exported to customer SIEM (CloudTrail, Stackdriver, Azure Monitor). Rotation and revocation procedures are documented; Redwood does not expose plaintext to its control plane"
tess_ae: I'll tell the customer we can do a scoped Private POC with transient BYOK, 2-week setup window, estimated infra delta 2–3k USD for the sandbox (finance to confirm).
maria_sales: Perfect — Jordan, drop the doc link and I'll paste into their risk form and close this out. :thumbsup:
